Manages user data and processes users.

This class is responsible for managing user data within the system. It provides methods to add users and process them based on their age. The class ensures that users are correctly added to the system and processed accordingly.

@attribute {User[]} users - Stores the list of users. This array is initialized when the class is instantiated and is modified by the `addUser` method.

@throws {Error} - This function does not throw any errors.
</DOCSTRING>
